results.label: vercel/chatbot
results.verdict: Solid bones, but the AI SDK calls are cosplaying as v5 docs
bugs: 'instructions' prop passed to streamText in artifacts/code/server.ts, artifacts/sheet/server.ts, artifacts/text/server.ts (not a valid option; use system)
createDocumentHandler type mismatch: config fns return Promise<string> but wrapper declares Promise<void> (lib/artifacts/server.ts)
quickWins: Add try/catch + dataStream error handling in all three document handlers
Remove duplicate dotenv config() calls across drizzle.config.ts and playwright.config.ts
next.config.ts: cacheComponents isn't a real flag in Next 16

results.label: vercel/nextjs-subscription-payments
results.verdict: Solid SaaS skeleton, but auth logic forgot to hang up the phone.
bugs: utils/auth-helpers/server.ts: signInWithEmail, requestPasswordUpdate, signUp, updatePassword set redirectPath on validation fail but never return, so execution continues with bad data
quickWins: utils/auth-helpers/server.ts: add early returns after every redirectPath assignment
utils/supabase/server.ts: assert env vars exist before createServerClient
utils/stripe/server.ts: validate price.id and trial_period_days before Stripe calls

results.label: stackblitz/bolt.new
results.verdict: Bolt.new zaps full-stack dreams but its homemade crypto shorts the circuit.
security: Custom AES-CBC in app/lib/crypto.ts uses raw string key with encodeBase64 and no key derivation or length checks
bugs: encrypt places IV after ciphertext then decrypt reads it correctly but getKey/importKey assumptions are fragile (app/lib/crypto.ts)
quickWins: Add key length validation and use crypto.subtle.generateKey or PBKDF2 in app/lib/crypto.ts
Replace console.log with proper logger in app/routes/api.chat.ts and api.enhancer.ts

results.label: shadcn-ui/taxonomy
results.verdict: Next.js 13 fossil: charming but held together with duct tape and 'as any'
security: PrismaAdapter(db as any) in lib/auth.ts bypasses types and hides potential adapter mismatches
bugs: GitHub sign-in in components/user-auth-form.tsx sets isGitHubLoading true but never resets it on redirect/failure
lib/db.ts global cachedPrisma pattern risks stale connections or multiple instances under hot reload
quickWins: Bump ancient next@13.3.2-canary.13 and typescript@4.7.4 in package.json
Add error handling around signIn('github') in user-auth-form.tsx

results.label: t3-oss/create-t3-app
results.verdict: T3 still slaps, but the auth spaghetti and stale next.config are giving me heartburn.
bugs: next.config.js: i18n still present despite comment warning it breaks appDir (used in all app router templates)
cli/src/cli/index.ts: auth select uses 'next-auth' value but installer map expects 'nextAuth' (and same for better-auth)
quickWins: cli/package.json: bump engines.node to match root (>=20) to avoid version skew
cli/template/extras/src/server/better-auth/server.ts: import from './index' instead of '.' for clarity
cli/src/index.ts: add explicit check that nextAuth + betterAuth were never both selected before install
